title: Shadow of the Self | ECHO//100 Episode 42
description:
Kavi confronts a temporal doppelgänger that threatens to dissolve his reality into digital static. He must sacrifice his only link to the past to preserve the future. Episode 42 of ECHO//100: ARC. This content was created with assistance from AI to produce original science-fiction storytelling.

This is original AI-assisted animated fiction.

scenes.text: The mirror-Kavi steps forward, crushing the golden floor into shimmering, weightless dust particles.
scenes.caption: Mirror Kavi emerges.
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in red hoodie and glasses facing his dark doppelganger in Mirror Plaza, vertical cinematic shot.

scenes.text: Gravity snaps like a broken string as Kavi's backpack and Byte drift toward ceiling beams.
scenes.caption: Gravity begins failing.
scenes.image_prompt: Byte with orange antenna and Kavi's backpack floating upward in low gravity, Mirror Plaza.

scenes.text: The shadow reaches out, not to strike, but to grasp the dead phone in Kavi's pocket.
scenes.caption: Shadow targets the phone.
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Kavi's hand gripping his dead smartphone, shadow-Kavi reaching with reaching fingers.

scenes.text: Kavi sees the truth etched in those eyes; the shadow represents every version that failed.
scenes.caption: Failed futures revealed.
scenes.image_prompt: Mirror-Kavi's face showing flickering reflections of alternate Kavis, Kavi looking shocked.

scenes.text: The plaza vibrates, threatening to tear the fabric of this New World into raw static.
scenes.caption: Reality starts fracturing.
scenes.image_prompt: The environment around Kavi cracking like glass, revealing swirling purple and black void behind.

scenes.text: Kavi must surrender the dead device or watch everything vanish into the digital abyss.
scenes.caption: The impossible choice.
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi extending his hand holding the dead phone toward the shadow-doppelganger, dramatic lighting.

scenes.text: Fingers release the cold metal; the shadow grabs it, instantly grounding himself into reality.
scenes.caption: Phone trade completed.
scenes.image_prompt: The dead phone transferring from Kavi's hand to the shadow's hand, glowing energy spark.

scenes.text: He taps the screen, dialing a physics-defying sequence while Kavi's own memories start fading.
scenes.caption: Shadow dials forbidden number.
scenes.image_prompt: Shadow-Kavi pressing buttons on the phone, screen glowing with impossible symbols, Kavi looking terrified.
